reviews.name: Kiyah Management
reviews.text: Outstanding Service from Start to Finish! I couldn’t be more impressed with the professionalism, quality, and attention to detail this company delivers. From the moment I reached out, they were responsive, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about my needs. The entire process was smooth and efficient, and the final results exceeded my expectations. It’s rare to find a company that combines exceptional customer service with top-notch craftsmanship, but they absolutely nailed it. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality work — you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.name: Chad Beach
reviews.text: BM Industrial Solutions gets five stars. They are reliable honest and operate with integrity. Bradley always takes the time to answer any questions I may have and provides me with all the options available from repair to replacement. Bradley is consistently competitive with his pricing and his actions always prove out to be in my best interest. I would recommend BM to anyone.

reviews.name: SV Escape Plan
reviews.text: First - I was impressed that my phone calls have either been answered right away, or messages responded to quickly. That was my first great impression. Bradley was quick to come out and assess our needs and very quick to do the needed repairs. He is very polite and considerate of keeping a clean entry/exit of your home. Would highly recommend, and use again.

reviews.name: Gordon
reviews.text: BM Industrial Solutions LLC has helped me on many occasions for various projects with many Industrial and Manufacturing Companies I deal with. Bradley is honest, trust worthy and always available 24/7. He has came up with many solutions to design and build and has never let me down. He works hard and gets the job done right! Highly recommend his company!

reviews.name: Tyler
reviews.text: I had BM Industrial come out to my property and run new power to my building I just had installed. Bradley was very professional and organized. The job was completed ahead of the scheduled deadline and the most important part for me was the fact that you couldn’t even tell he was there because of how clean he was. I can’t recommend BM Industrial enough!

reviews.name: Dalton Delp
reviews.text: Bradley (owner) is a qualified and knowledgeable professional that always gets the job done no matter the situation. I have relied on Bradley for many years and he has never disappointed. I would recommend BM Industrial Solutions to anyone that is in need of a jack of all trades to get the job done.

reviews.text: I have nothing but the best things to say about the owner Bradley and his crew. They are extremely efficient and quick to respond when I needed information throughout the job.
